card.name: Words leading up to border or asylum terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words and partway-through words in passages about borders, asylum, immigration and trade, just before a border or entry-related word is expected.

modes.label: Asylum and entry rules
modes.description: Linking words inside sentences about asylum claims, deportation and arrival in a country.
modes.example: asylum-seekers being returned to<< the>> EU member state in which they first arrived

modes.label: Border crossings
modes.description: The word 'the' or 'at' just before a border name.
modes.example: simple inspection of vehicles for smuggled goods at<< the>> US-Mexico border

modes.label: Trade measures list
modes.description: Words inside the phrase sanitary and phytosanitary measures, technical barriers to trade.
